decision_rule: R2 is immutable. Approved spatial economy, ecology, climate and population anchors may inform active simulation only through versioned engine-neutral contracts; runtime numbers, Godot code and future UE5 state never become canon automatically.
story_generators: A scarcity signal exposes a route dependency without declaring a canonical price.
Climate pressure changes a settlement's choices without rewriting its population history.
A future UE5 simulation proposes a gate instead of silently creating a disaster.
